description: This file provides utility functions for string formatting, specifically converting strings to camelCase and Title Case for display within the application. It centralizes string normalization routines used by the UI components to ensure consistency.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase by handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and collapsing multiple whitespace. Returns the original value if not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case for display, handling delimiters, multiple spaces, and special characters such as apostrophes and accented characters, ensuring proper capitalization.
